name: hometape
description: Make and preview home movies through the installed HomeTape app.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop or another MCPB client to HomeTape's installed local MCP helper. The same app planner, media renderer, free allowance, and existing paid licence apply. Processing requires approval in the app; purchases require fresh approval. Media stays on the device. Requires the HomeTape macOS app with its bundled MCP helper. This extension does not provide cloud access to local videos.

helper_path.title: HomeTape MCP helper
helper_path.description: Absolute path to the MCP helper bundled with the installed HomeTape app.
